name: cc-tuner
description: Tune Claude Code's own configuration. Start with /cc-tuner:setup, which checks CLI tools, gh scopes, companion plugins and MCP servers before running the installers this repo needs. Ships claude-md-writer (audit CLAUDE.md / .claude/rules/ memory against the official docs) and a usage statusline (rate-limit + context %, /cc-tuner:statusline-setup). Plus the task loop split in two: /cc-tuner:spec grills and commits a machine-checkable spec on its task branch, and /cc-tuner:run [--auto] executes it through PR and merge (requires mattpocock-skills + cc-codex-triage); task-flow (canonical branch/commit/PR/board conventions + /cc-tuner:task-flow-setup rule installer); smoke-verify (opt-in Stop-hook gate: frontend changes must be exercised for real before the turn ends).
